# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta6

## Flicker-free active mowing refresh

This prerelease removes the brief map repaint visible during active mowing when Home Assistant map-state revisions arrive every few seconds.

- Keep static map geometry mounted when only coverage, zone-state or vendor-trail progress changes.
- Update zone percentage labels in place instead of rebuilding the static SVG layers.
- Update the retained current-cycle mowing SVG path in place when the vendor geometry revision advances.
- Update the live MQTT tail polyline in place when its segment structure is unchanged.
- Preserve the existing persistent vendor-cycle and unbounded live-tail semantics from 0.3.7-beta5.
- Add regression coverage for static-cache stability, incremental zone labels, current-cycle path updates and live-tail DOM stability.

Pair with Navimower 0.4.5-beta11 or newer.
